push notification.note: Mobile settings use 'Push-notifieringar' (majority in mobile); 'push-notiser' appears once and webapp admin uses 'pushavisering'. Keep 'push-notifiering' in the mobile app, aligned with notification = 'notifiering'.

share extension.note: No existing sv translation; standard iOS Swedish term for a share extension.

bottom sheet.note: No existing sv translation; rarely user-visible. In running text, 'panelen längst ned' also works.

long-press.note: Existing: 'tryck länge på ett meddelande'. Imperative: 'Tryck länge på …'.

tap.note: Swedish mobile convention: 'tryck på' (not 'knacka' or 'klicka'). Imperative: 'Tryck på …'.

toast.note: Developer term with no established Swedish equivalent; rarely user-visible. If it must appear in UI text, paraphrase as 'tillfälligt meddelande'.

passcode.note: Apple's official Swedish term. Existing strings are inconsistent (keep 'Passcode' or use 'lösenord') — prefer 'lösenkod'; do not use 'lösenord' (= password).

jailbroken.note: Existing uses the nonstandard spelling 'jailbrejkad'; prefer 'jailbreakad'. Android equivalent: 'rootad'. Pair as 'jailbreakade eller rootade enheter'.

app logs.note: Existing consistently uses 'app-loggar' (heading 'APP LOGGAR'). Solid compound 'apploggar' is also correct, but keep the existing hyphenated form.

deep link.note: No existing sv translation; standard Swedish tech term.

skin tone.note: Majority rendering (13 vs 4 for 'hudton'); matches Apple/Google emoji settings.

server connection.note: Add a server = 'Lägg till en server'; switch server = 'byt server'.
